options.name: dictcheck
options.description: Check if the password is a dictionary word. Requires IPA 4.9+. (bool or "")

options.name: failinterval
options.description: Period after which failure count will be reset (seconds). (int or "")

options.name: gracelimit
options.description: Number of LDAP authentications allowed after expiration. Requires IPA 4.10.1+. (int or "")

options.name: history
options.description: Password history size. (int or "")

options.name: ipaadmin_password
options.description: The admin password.

options.name: ipaadmin_principal
options.description: The admin principal.

options.name: ipaapi_context
options.description:
The context in which the module will execute. Executing in a
server context is preferred. If not provided context will be
determined by the execution environment.

options.name: ipaapi_ldap_cache
options.description: Use LDAP cache for IPA connection.

options.name: lockouttime
options.description: Period for which lockout is enforced (seconds). (int or "")

options.name: maxfail
options.description: Consecutive failures before lockout. (int or "")

options.name: maxlife
options.description: Maximum password lifetime (in days). (int or "")

options.name: maxrepeat
options.description: Maximum number of same consecutive characters. Requires IPA 4.9+. (int or "")

options.name: maxsequence
options.description: The maximum length of monotonic character sequences (abcd). Requires IPA 4.9+. (int or "")

options.name: minclasses
options.description: Minimum number of character classes. (int or "")

options.name: minlength
options.description: Minimum length of password. (int or "")

options.name: minlife
options.description: Minimum password lifetime (in hours). (int or "")

options.name: name
options.description: The group name

options.name: priority
options.description: Priority of the policy (higher number means lower priority). (int or "")

options.name: state
options.description: State to ensure
